schedule.title: Welcome Reception
schedule.speaker: Gala Committee
schedule.description: Guest arrival and socializing before the main event.
highlights: Private walk-through of the museum-grade ceramics showcase
Early access to silent bidding and exhibition catalog

schedule.title: Opening Address and Keynote
schedule.speaker: Chief Curator & Guest Art Historian
schedule.description: Keynote presentation on safeguarding indigenous ceramic methods and high-fire kiln traditions.
highlights: Keynote: 'Preserving Millennia of High-Fire Kiln Traditions'
Announcement of the 2027 Fully-Funded Ceramic Fellowships
Showcase of 3D photogrammetry technology in pottery conservation

schedule.title: Live Masterclass Ceramic Demonstration
schedule.speaker: Master Potter & Kintsugi Conservator
schedule.description: Live wheel-throwing, decorative taotie relief carving, and traditional Kintsugi urushi lacquer repair demonstrated by guest resident artisans.
highlights: Precision wheel-throwing of large-format stoneware vessels
Surface relief carving inspired by ancient Zhou dynasty motifs
Live 24k gold powder Kintsugi restoration demonstration

schedule.title: Charity Auction & Conservation Fundraiser
schedule.speaker: Auctioneer & Resident Artists
schedule.description: Live benefit auction of curated original ceramic artworks and archival replicas, with 100% of proceeds supporting community fellowships.
highlights: Live bidding on museum-caliber contemporary and historical ceramics
Instant charitable tax receipt generation for winning bids
Artist-led introductions detailing each work's creation process

schedule.title: Closing Toast & Private Collection Access
schedule.speaker: Guild Leadership & Benefactor Hosts
schedule.description: Closing remarks, patron acknowledgments, artwork allocation documentation, and an evening dessert reception with the artists.
highlights: Closing toast and gratitude address to supporters and benefactors
Winning collector registration and authenticity certification
Dessert reception and informal Q&A with master potters

tiers.name: Supporter Pass
tiers.description: Full access to reception, keynotes, live demonstrations, and silent auction.

tiers.name: Patron Circle
tiers.description: Elevated gala experience with priority seating, VIP lounge access, and catalog recognition.
perks: VIP lounge access & private tasting bar
Named acknowledgment in official Gala program

tiers.name: Founding Benefactor
tiers.description: Premier gala patron status championing living artisan fellowships and heritage preservation.
perks: Private pre-reception dinner with keynote curators & master artisans
Exclusive hand-thrown ceramic vessel gift created by resident artist
